```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(clustree)
library(scater)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)
library(viridis)
library(Polychrome)
library(magick)
library(png)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ggtext)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplotify)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))
source(here("code", "limma_barcodeplot_custom.R"))
# using customised version of the barcode plot function to make the font size bigger and change shade of background colour
# as cannot pass cex arguments to the original barcodeplot function
# https://support.bioconductor.org/p/119752/

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

Prepare colour schemes for the plots

```{r}
ALL_DONORS_COLOURS <- ALL_DONORS_COLOURS[-3]
ALL_DONORS_COLOURS <- ALL_DONORS_COLOURS[1:5]

DONOR.PAPER <- c("AF_1", "AF_2", "AF_3", "AF_4", "AF_5", "AF_6", "AF_7", 
                 "AF_1.optref", "AF_2.optref", "AF_3.optref", "AF_4.optref", "AF_5.optref")
names(DONOR.PAPER) <- c("1AF", "2AF", "4AF", "5AF", "6AF", "7AF", "8AF", 
                        "1AF_optref", "2AF_optref", "4AF_optref", "5AF_optref", "6AF_optref")

names(ALL_DONORS_COLOURS) <- DONOR.PAPER[names(ALL_DONORS_COLOURS)]

ALL_DONORS_COLOURS <- c(ALL_DONORS_COLOURS[1:5], 
                        "darkorange3", "mediumpurple", 
                        "darkgreen", "deeppink2", "dodgerblue")
names(ALL_DONORS_COLOURS) <- c(names(ALL_DONORS_COLOURS)[1:5], 
                               "AF_1.optref", "AF_2.optref", 
                               "AF_3.optref", "AF_4.optref", "AF_5.optref")
```

The `seu_int.AmnioSC` object was generated on [this page](AmnioSC_workflow_optref_refined_annotations.html).
The `seu_int.Gerli` object was generated on [this page](Gerli_et_al_2024.refined_annotations.html).

```{r}
seu_int.Gerli <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024",
                              "Gerli_et_al_2024.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
seu_int.Gerli$Dataset_Source <- "Gerli et al. (2024) Dataset"
```

```{r}
seu_int.AmnioSC <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow",
                                "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
seu_int.AmnioSC$Dataset_Source <- "Our Dataset"

seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor <- DONOR.PAPER[seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor]
seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor <- factor(seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor.Paper)
```

# Supplementary Figure 4

## Generate the plots

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_cluster <- plotNCells.Paper(seu_int.Gerli, x_var = "cluster_names",
                                                    color_by = "cluster_names",
                                                    colour_scheme = CLUSTER_NAME_COLOURS.GERLI,
                                                    title = "Number of cells per cluster",
                                                    subtitle = "Gerli et al. (2024) Dataset",
                                                    xlab = "", ylab = "Number of cells", ymax = 25000)
supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_cluster

saveRDS(supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_cluster, 
        here("output", "supp_figures", "supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_cluster.rds"))

supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_pan_fetal <- plotNCells.Paper(seu_int.Gerli, x_var = "pan_fetal.majority_voting",
                                                      color_by = "pan_fetal.majority_voting",
                                                      colour_scheme = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS,
                                                      title = "Number of cells per<br>*Pan_Fetal_Human* annotation",
                                                      subtitle = "Gerli et al. (2024) Dataset",
                                                      xlab = "", ylab = "Number of cells", ymax = 20000)

        here("output", "supp_figures", "supp_fig4.Gerli_n_cells_pan_fetal.rds"))
```


```{r, fig.width=24, fig.height=8}
Gerli.canonical_markers.reduced <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "Gerli_et_al_2024.canonical_markers.reduced.rds"))
Gerli.canonical_markers.reduced <- Gerli.canonical_markers.reduced[levels(seu_int.Gerli$cluster_names)]

canonical_markers.reduced <- unique(unlist(Gerli.canonical_markers.reduced, use.names = FALSE))
canonical_markers.reduced <- filterPresentGenes(canonical_markers.reduced, seu_int.Gerli)

seu_int.Gerli$cluster_names.rev <- sortedFactor(seu_int.Gerli$cluster_names, decreasing = FALSE)

DotPlot(object = seu_int.Gerli, features = canonical_markers.reduced, assay = "RNA",
        group.by = "cluster_names.rev", col.max = 5) +
  geom_point(aes(size=pct.exp), shape = 21, colour="black", stroke=0.5) +
  scale_size("% detected", range = c(0,6)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "gray95", high = "#39157B",
                       guide = guide_colorbar(ticks.colour = "black",
                                              frame.colour = "black"),
                       name = "Average\nexpression") +
  ggtitle("Selected canonical marker genes") + 
  theme_linedraw() + rotate_x_labels +
  labs(subtitle = "Gerli et al. (2024) Dataset") +
   ylab("") + xlab("") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(size = 24, face = "bold", family = "arial"),
        plot.subtitle = element_markdown(size = 22, face = "italic", family = "arial"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold.italic", family = "arial"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18, family = "arial"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, family = "arial", face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 18, family = "arial"),
        axis.title.x = element_markdown(family = "arial", size = 22, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22)) -> supp_fig4.Gerli_dot_plot
supp_fig4.Gerli_dot_plot

saveRDS(supp_fig4.Gerli_dot_plot, here("output", "supp_figures", "supp_fig4.Gerli_dot_plot.rds"))
```

# Supplementary Figure 5

## Generate the plots

The `AmnioSC.sccomp_result` object was generated on [this page](AmnioSC_workflow_optref_cluster_proportions_sccomp.html).

```{r}
AmnioSC.sccomp_result <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.sccomp_result.rds"))

seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late <- seu_int.AmnioSC[,seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor != "AF_4"]
seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late$Donor <- factor(seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late$Donor)
seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late$early_late_gestation <- factor(seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late$early_late_gestation)

AmnioSC.prop_df <- generateGroupProportionsDF(seu_int.AmnioSC_early_late,
                                              group_var = "cluster_names")
```

```{r}
ILC3_genes <- c("IL23R", "KLRB1", "KIT", "IL7R", "ZBTB16", "CD96", "CD69", "RORC", 
                "IL17A", "NCR2", "LTB", "CD52")

seu_int.AmnioSC.early_late <- seu_int.AmnioSC[, seu_int.AmnioSC$Donor.Paper != "AF_4"]

# following this tutorial: https://github.com/dpcook/code_snippets/blob/main/20210510_recreate_seurat_dotplot/recreate_seurat_dotplot.md
exp_mat <- as.matrix(seu_int.AmnioSC.early_late[["SCT"]]@data[ILC3_genes,])
meta <- seu_int.AmnioSC.early_late@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation, cluster_names)

meta <- bind_cols(meta, as.data.frame(t(exp_mat)))
head(meta)

meta <- pivot_longer(meta, -c(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation, cluster_names), 
                     names_to="Gene", values_to="Expression")
head(meta)

meta_summary <- meta %>%
  group_by(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation, cluster_names, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Avg = mean(Expression),
            Pct = sum(Expression > 0) / length(Expression) * 100)
```

## Generate the plots

```{r}
EDC_GENES <- read_tsv(file = here("data", "edc_genes.txt"))
EDC_GENES <- EDC_GENES$`Approved symbol`
EDC.ENTREZ <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, 
                             keys = EDC_GENES, 
                             column = c("ENTREZID"),
                             keytype = "SYMBOL",
                             multiVals = "first")
```

The `lrt.AmnioSC` and `fit.AmnioSC` objects were generated on [this page](AmnioSC_workflow_optref_dge_ruvseq.cluster_0.html).

```{r}
fit.AmnioSC <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.dge_early_vs_late.fit.rds"))
lrt.AmnioSC <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.dge_early_vs_late.lrt.rds"))

# fix floating point representation issue
lrt.AmnioSC$table$LR <- pmax(lrt.AmnioSC$table$LR, 0) # Converts all negative values to 0
statistic.AmnioSC <- sign(lrt.AmnioSC$table$logFC) * sqrt(lrt.AmnioSC$table$LR)

gns.AmnioSC <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
                             keys = rownames(fit.AmnioSC),
                             column = c("ENTREZID"),
                             keytype = "SYMBOL",
                             multiVals = "first")

edc.id.AmnioSC <- ids2indices(EDC.ENTREZ, unname(gns.AmnioSC[rownames(lrt.AmnioSC)]))
edc.cam.AmnioSC <- cameraPR(statistic.AmnioSC, edc.id.AmnioSC)
edc.cam.AmnioSC
```


The `contr.Gerli` object was generated on [this page]().

```{r}
contr.Gerli <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024",
                            "Gerli_et_al_2024.dge_early_vs_late.contr.rds"))
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
pal <- c(paletteer::paletteer_d("RColorBrewer::Set1")[2:1], "grey")

# DGE results summary
cutoff <- 0.05

# set index for current contrast
i = 1
  
dt.Gerli <- lapply(1:ncol(contr.Gerli), function(i){
  decideTests(glmLRT(fit.Gerli, contrast = contr.Gerli[,i]),
                            p.value = cutoff)
})

lrt.Gerli <- glmLRT(fit.Gerli, contrast = contr.Gerli[,i])
topTags(lrt.Gerli, n = Inf) %>% data.frame -> top.Gerli

top_genes_to_label <- top.Gerli %>% filter(FDR < cutoff,
                                     abs(logFC) > 3 | PValue < 0.0000001)

top.Gerli$label_this <- rownames(top.Gerli) %in% rownames(top_genes_to_label)
table(top.Gerli$label_this)

top.Gerli %>% 
  mutate(sig = ifelse(FDR <= cutoff, glue::glue("<= {cutoff}"), 
                      glue::glue("> {cutoff}"))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "SYMBOL") %>%
  left_join(dt.Gerli[[i]][,1] %>% 
              data.frame %>%
              rownames_to_column(var = "SYMBOL") %>%
              dplyr::rename(status = 2)) %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(status == 1, "Up",
                         ifelse(status == -1, "Down",
                                "NotSig"))) %>%
  mutate(status = as.factor(status)) %>%
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(status, "NotSig", after = Inf)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(PValue), color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = function(x) subset(x, label_this == TRUE), 
                           aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(PValue), 
                               label = SYMBOL), 
                           size = 6, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 50) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  theme_linedraw() + 
  labs(title = "DEGs in Keratinocytes", 
       subtitle = "Early vs Late Gestational Age Groups\nGerli et al. (2024) Dataset",
       x = "log<sub>2</sub>(Fold Change)",
       y = "-log<sub>10</sub>(P-value)",
       colour = glue::glue("FDR < {cutoff}")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, hjust = 0.5, family = "arial"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 22, hjust = 0.5, family = "arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 22, face = "bold", family = "arial"),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 22, face = "bold", family = "arial"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, family = "arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, family = "arial", face = "bold.italic"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18, family = "arial")) -> supp_fig6.Gerli_volcano
supp_fig6.Gerli_volcano

saveRDS(supp_fig6.Gerli_volcano, 
        here("output", "supp_figures", "supp_fig6.Gerli_volcano.rds"))
```
